name: header_analyzer
description: Fetch and analyze HTTP response headers for a URL: full headers, a security-headers audit, detected server/technology, or an explanation of what a specific header means.

action.description: get_headers: all raw response headers. security_audit: check for missing security headers with a score. detect_server: identify the web server/tech stack. explain_header: explain what a specific header name+value means (no network request needed).

url.description: The URL to fetch headers from. Required for get_headers, security_audit, detect_server.

header_name.description: A specific header name to explain (e.g. 'X-Frame-Options'). Required for action='explain_header'.

header_value.description: The value of that header, if known. Required for action='explain_header'.
